findings.text: Moderator dim_irq_moder groups flag bytes profile_flags with coal_flags and mode selectors dim_rx_mode with dim_tx_mode, plus RCU guarded profile references rx_profile with tx_profile and deferred handlers rx_dim_work with tx_dim_work for receive versus transmit adaptation.

Sample dim_sample carries time with pkt_ctr and byte_ctr plus event_ctr and comp_ctr; rates dim_stats carry ppms with bpms and epms plus cpms and cpe_ratio; controller dim carries state with prev_stats plus start_sample and measuring_sample plus work and priv plus profile_ix with mode and tune_state plus steps_right with steps_left and tired.

Enums dim_cq_period_mode with dim_state and dim_tune_state plus dim_stats_state and dim_step_result define transitions where period origin chooses DIM_CQ_PERIOD_MODE_START_FROM_EQE versus DIM_CQ_PERIOD_MODE_START_FROM_CQE with DIM_CQ_PERIOD_NUM_MODES bound while measurement advances DIM_START_MEASURE then DIM_MEASURE_IN_PROGRESS then DIM_APPLY_NEW_PROFILE while tuner rests at DIM_PARKING_ON_TOP versus DIM_PARKING_TIRED or travels DIM_GOING_RIGHT versus DIM_GOING_LEFT while comparison yields DIM_STATS_WORSE versus DIM_STATS_SAME versus DIM_STATS_BETTER and stepping yields DIM_STEPPED versus DIM_TOO_TIRED versus DIM_ON_EDGE.

Updater dim_update_sample writes current time into time and copies event_ctr with packets into pkt_ctr and bytes into byte_ctr for sample s; extended updater dim_update_sample_with_comps delegates to basic updater then stores comps into comp_ctr.
RDMA constants RDMA_DIM_PARAMS_NUM_PROFILES with RDMA_DIM_START_PROFILE define nine profiles indexed from zero.
Entry linux_dirent64 carries inode d_ino with offset d_off plus length d_reclen and type d_type followed by variable name d_name.
Digest dm_verity_loadpin_trusted_root_digest links via node and carries length len with trailing data bytes sized by len.
Query dm_verity_loadpin_is_bdev_trusted unconditionally reports untrusted for any block device.

Header dmi_header packs type with length and handle; device dmi_device links via list and carries numeric type with name and opaque device_data; entry dmi_a_info_entry packs length with handle and offset plus string number and trailing value bytes; container dmi_a_info packs header with count; onboard dmi_dev_onboard extends device with instance plus segment and bus plus device function, with packed layout where noted.

Device kinds dmi_device_type include DMI_DEV_TYPE_ANY at zero with video and SCSI and Ethernet among positives and negatives DMI_DEV_TYPE_IPMI versus DMI_DEV_TYPE_OEM_STRING versus DMI_DEV_TYPE_DEV_ONBOARD versus DMI_DEV_TYPE_DEV_SLOT; record kinds dmi_entry_type start at DMI_ENTRY_BIOS and reach DMI_ENTRY_FIRMWARE_INVENTORY with DMI_ENTRY_STRING_PROPERTY before DMI_ENTRY_INACTIVE versus DMI_ENTRY_END_OF_TABLE terminators.
Additional info minima DMI_A_INFO_ENT_MIN_SIZE with DMI_A_INFO_MIN_SIZE are six for entry and eleven for container.

Helpers dmi_check_system with dmi_get_system_info and dmi_find_device plus dmi_setup and dmi_get_date plus dmi_get_bios_year and dmi_name_in_vendors plus dmi_name_in_serial and dmi_available plus dmi_walk and dmi_match plus dmi_memdev_name and dmi_memdev_size plus dmi_memdev_type and dmi_memdev_handle plus dmi_first_match and dmi_string_nosave are inert when firmware support is unavailable: system check with vendor and serial tests report zero, system info with device search and first match report null, setup with memory naming do nothing, date fetch zeroes outputs and reports false, BIOS year with table walk report not present, availability with string match report false, memory size reports all bits set with type zero and handle all bits set, and string fetch reports empty.
Watch dnotify_struct links via dn_next and carries mask dn_mask with descriptor dn_fd plus file pointer dn_filp and owner dn_owner.

Aggregate DNOTIFY_ALL_EVENTS is the OR of twelve file system event bits covering delete with child and modify with child plus access with child and attribute with child plus create and rename plus moved from and moved to.
Flush dnotify_flush is a no operation and control fcntl_dirnotify always reports invalid argument.

Descriptor _ddebug stores modname with function and filename plus format and lineno with class_id and flags plus optional key, aligned to eight; kinds class_map_type distinguish disjoint bits versus numeric levels versus disjoint names versus level names; map ddebug_class_map carries link with mod and mod_name plus class_names and length with base and map_type; index _ddebug_info carries descs with classes plus num_descs and num_classes; parameter ddebug_class_param offers bits versus lvl with flags and map.

Identifier width CLS_BITS is six with default _DPRINTK_CLASS_DFLT selecting all bits set; none _DPRINTK_FLAGS_NONE is zero with print _DPRINTK_FLAGS_PRINT on bit zero and inclusions _DPRINTK_FLAGS_INCL_MODNAME versus _DPRINTK_FLAGS_INCL_FUNCNAME versus _DPRINTK_FLAGS_INCL_LINENO versus _DPRINTK_FLAGS_INCL_TID versus _DPRINTK_FLAGS_INCL_SOURCENAME versus _DPRINTK_FLAGS_INCL_STACK on following bits, any _DPRINTK_FLAGS_INCL_ANY being their OR, and default _DPRINTK_FLAGS_DEFAULT enabling print only in debug builds.

Declaration DECLARE_DYNDBG_CLASSMAP with counter NUM_TYPE_ARGS builds classname array and section map tied to current module with base and kind and computed length; definition DEFINE_DYNAMIC_DEBUG_METADATA_CLS with DEFINE_DYNAMIC_DEBUG_METADATA creates section descriptor capturing module function file format line with default flags and supplied class and rejects overflow; tester DYNAMIC_DEBUG_BRANCH with initializer _DPRINTK_KEY_INIT selects static key likely or unlikely path when jump labels exist and otherwise tests print flag with likely or unlikely hint, collapsing to false when disabled; helper __dynamic_dump_stack dumps stack when requested.

Wrappers __dynamic_func_call_cls with __dynamic_func_call plus __dynamic_func_call_cls_no_desc with __dynamic_func_call_no_desc emit metadata then conditionally invoke supplied routine with descriptor or plain arguments and dump stack when requested; unique wrappers _dynamic_func_call_cls with _dynamic_func_call plus _dynamic_func_call_cls_no_desc with _dynamic_func_call_no_desc hide naming; shorthands dynamic_pr_debug_cls with dynamic_pr_debug plus dynamic_dev_dbg with dynamic_netdev_dbg plus dynamic_ibdev_dbg with dynamic_hex_dump route through same gate; disabled builds replace printing with non printing stubs; checker __pr_debug_cls requires constant class.

Callback ddebug_dyndbg_module_param_cb warns and accepts legacy dyndbg name in non debug builds and rejects other names as invalid; helpers param_set_dyndbg_classes with param_get_dyndbg_classes report success without effect in this configuration.

State dql separates enqueue num_queued with adj_limit and last_obj_cnt plus stall_thrs and history_head with history ring from completion limit with num_completed and prev_ovlimit plus prev_num_queued and prev_last_obj_cnt with lowest_slack and slack_start_time, followed by max_limit with min_limit and slack_hold_time plus stall_max with last_reap and stall_cnt; history DQL_HIST_LEN is four slots indexed by DQL_HIST_ENT modulo length while limit is cacheline isolated.
Bounds DQL_MAX_OBJECT with DQL_MAX_LIMIT define largest single object as one sixteenth of maximum unsigned value and largest limit as one half of maximum unsigned value minus that object bound.

Routine dql_queued records object count and increments total queued, populating stall history only when threshold is set; routine dql_queue_stall advances history head with slot clearing when time bucket changes and sets current slot bit once; routine dql_avail reports adjusted limit minus queued total.

Enqueue and completion sides coordinate without locks via ordered accesses where dql_queued with dql_queue_stall and dql_avail use ordered writes for last count with history slots and history head plus write barrier pairing head update to readers and compiler barrier encouraging ownership, while threshold with adjusted limit and queued total use ordered reads and limit in dql is isolated on its own cache line.
Pointers rx_profile with tx_profile in dim_irq_moder are RCU guarded and require RCU read protection with deferred freeing on update.
Entry cpio_data pairs data pointer with size and fixed name buffer.
Limit MAX_CPIO_FILE_NAME is eighteen bytes.

Versions ECRYPTFS_VERSION_MAJOR with ECRYPTFS_VERSION_MINOR and ECRYPTFS_SUPPORTED_FILE_VERSION are zero major with minor four supporting file three; features ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_PASSPHRASE with ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_PUBKEY and ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_PLAINTEXT_PASSTHROUGH plus ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_POLICY and ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_XATTR plus ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_MULTKEY and ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_DEVMISC plus ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_HMAC and ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_FILENAME_ENCRYPTION plus ECRYPTFS_VERSIONING_GCM are successive powers of two from bit zero to bit nine; lengths ECRYPTFS_MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH with ECRYPTFS_MAX_PASSPHRASE_BYTES are sixty four with salt ECRYPTFS_SALT_SIZE eight bytes and hex ECRYPTFS_SALT_SIZE_HEX sixteen characters.

Guards _LINUX_DIRENT_H with __LINUX_DM_VERITY_LOADPIN_H and __DMI_H__ plus _LINUX_DNOTIFY_H and _DYNAMIC_DEBUG_H plus _LINUX_DQL_H and _LINUX_EARLYCPIO_H plus _LINUX_ECRYPTFS_H each prevent multiple inclusion of their header.
